label: Diagram 15.1
caption: Diagram 15.1 Components of a firefighting shaft | 900m2
description: "See paras 15.2, 15.8 and 15.9" appears top left. The drawing shows two floor plans. a. "Any building": a dark‑green‑walled plan containing a "Fire main outlet" symbol at top left, a "Firefighting lobby" with a doorway on its left wall and a doorway on its right wall opening to the stairs, "Firefighting stairs" drawn with treads and a vertical double arrow, and a "Firefighting lift in lift shaft" at bottom left. b. "Firefighting shafts serving flats": a "Fire main outlet" symbol at top right, a "Common corridor" with two doorways on its left wall and a doorway on its right wall toward the stairs, a diagonal double arrow marked "7.5m max." between corridor and stair, "Firefighting stairs" with treads and a vertical double arrow, and a "Firefighting lift in lift shaft" at the bottom left. A legend gives two wall colours: dark green for "Minimum fire resistance REI 120 from accommodation side and REI 60 from inside the shaft with E 60 S a fire doors"; light green for "Minimum fire resistance REI 60 from both sides with E 30 S a fire doors". Below, under the heading "NOTES:", are notes numbered 1 to 5.
